speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Take the trencher while the broth has its fat on it. Threepence, and the loaf wants a full thumb of my husband's notch, as it has since June.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The room above my head has been still all afternoon. I have heard no walking at all.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You chide me on the days I walk, and you distrust me on the day I sit.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: When a player paces, I know whether he is killing a king or wooing a wench by the heel of his shoe. When he makes no sound, I distrust the quiet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I wrote a letter home. It is sealed, for Master Hobbins, on the eleventh.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A whole afternoon for one letter? My husband could engross an indenture before evensong.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I made three beginnings and struck them. The fourth I kept. The short one takes the time.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A short letter to a wife has less room for lies in it. Eat, before the cat comes for the crust.
